\pl{0.00}{DAILY PRAYERS.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{HOURS OF PRAYER.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{ALWAYS.}
\pl{1.20}{Without ceasing.}
\pl{1.20}{At every season.}
\pl{0.00}{Three seasons of the day he was bowing upon his knees,}
\pl{1.20}{and praying, and giving thanks before his God,}
\pl{1.20}{as he did aforetime.}
\pl{0.00}{Evening and morning and at noonday will I declare it,}
\pl{1.20}{and make it known, and he shall hear my voice.}
\pl{0.00}{Seven times a day have I praised thee.}
\pl{1.20}{1. Early in the morning, a great while before day.}
\pl{1.20}{2. At the dawning.}
\pl{1.20}{3. At the third hour of the day.}
\pl{1.20}{4. About the sixth hour.}
\pl{1.20}{5. At the ninth hour, the hour of prayer.}
\pl{1.20}{6. Toward the eventide.}
\pl{1.20}{7. In the night watches.}
\pl{2.40}{At midnight.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{PLACES OF PRAYER.}
\pl{0.00}{In every place where I record my name, thither will I come unto thee, and}
\pl{1.20}{I will bless thee.}
\pl{2.40}{The congregation.}
\pl{0.00}{In the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.}
}

\pl{0.00}{But words of iniquities have prevailed against me;}

\pl{1.20}{cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy}

\pl{1.20}{house.}
\pl{0.00}{Remember the brethren that stand about us, and pray}
\pl{1.20}{together with us in this hour.}
\pl{0.00}{Remember their readiness and their diligence.}
\pl{0.00}{Remember also them that for reasonable causes are absent, and}
\pl{1.20}{have mercy upon them and upon us according to the multitude of thy mercy,}
\pl{1.20}{O Lord.}
\pl{0.00}{Let us call blessed the godly kings, the orthodox chief bishops,}

\pl{0.00}{CONFESSIONS.}
\pl{0.00}{Woe is me, I have sinned against thee, O Lord, I have sinned against thee.}

\pl{1.20}{and thou hast not requited me as my sins deserved.}
\pl{2.40}{But I am ashamed,}
\pl{0.00}{and I turn away from my evil ways,}
\pl{0.00}{and I turn again unto mine own heart,}
\pl{0.00}{and with my whole heart I turn again unto thee.}
\pl{2.40}{And I seek thy face,}
\pl{3.60}{and I beseech thee, saying,}
\pl{1.20}{I have sinned, I have done iniquity, I have done wickedly;}
\pl{1.20}{I know, O Lord, the plague of mine own heart,}
\pl{1.20}{and behold, I turn again unto thee}
\pl{2.40}{with all my heart, and}
\pl{2.40}{with all my strength.}
\pl{0.00}{And now thou, O Lord, from thy dwelling place,}
\pl{1.20}{from the throne of the glory of thy kingdom in the heavens,}
\pl{2.40}{hear thou the prayer}
\pl{3.60}{and the supplication of thy servant,}
\pl{4.80}{and be merciful unto thy servant,}
\pl{6.00}{and heal his soul.}

\pl{1.20}{unto heaven,}

\pl{1.20}{Τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν\hspace{3.60em}Παράσχου, Κύριε.}

\pl{0.00}{ΟΥΣΙΑ ὑπερούσιε, φύσις ἄκτιστε,}
\pl{1.20}{Τοῦ ὅλου δημιουργὲ,}
\pl{0.00}{Προορῶ σε, Κύριε, ἐνώπιόν μου,}
\pl{0.00}{Καὶ ἀείρω πρός σε τὴν ψυχήν μου.}
\pl{0.00}{Προσκυνῶ σε θεὶς τὰ γόνατα,}
\pl{1.20}{Καὶ ταπεινοῦμαι ὑπὸ τὴν κραταιάν σου χεῖρα.}
\pl{1.20}{Διαπεταννύω πρός σε τὰς χεῖράς μου,}
\pl{0.00}{Ἡ ψυχή μου γῆ ἄνυδρός σοι.}
\pl{2.40}{Τύπτω εἰς τὸ στῆθός μου,}
\pl{2.40}{Καὶ λέγω μετὰ Τελωνοῦ,}
\pl{0.00}{Ὁ Θεὸς ἱλάσθητί μοι \{ τῷ ἁμαρτωλῷ, / τῷ πάνυ. \}}
\pl{2.40}{Τῷ ἁμαρτωλῷ ὑπὲρ Τελωνοῦ}
\pl{2.40}{Ἱλάσθητι ὥσπερ τῷ Τελωνῇ.}
\pl{2.40}{Πάτερ οἰκτιρμῶν,}
\pl{1.20}{Δέομαι τῆς πατρικῆς σου εὐσπλαγχνίας,}
\pl{1.20}{Μή με παρίδῃς \{ Σκώληκα ῥυπαρόν. / Κύνα τεθνηκότα. / Θνησιμαῖον σαπρόν. \}}

\pglabel{printed 18}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise,}
\pl{1.20}{to think on these things, and to do these things —}
\pl{3.60}{Grant, O Lord.}
\pl{0.00}{A Christian ending to our life,}
\pl{1.20}{without sin, without shame,}
\pl{1.20}{and, if it seem good to thee, without pain,}
\pl{0.00}{And a good defence before the dread}
\pl{1.20}{and fearful judgement-seat of Jesus Christ}
\pl{1.20}{our Lord —}
\pl{3.60}{Grant, O Lord.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O BEING beyond all being, nature uncreated,}
\pl{1.20}{Maker of the whole,}
\pl{0.00}{I have set thee, O Lord, before me,}
\pl{0.00}{And I lift up my soul unto thee.}
\pl{0.00}{I worship thee, bowing my knees,}
\pl{1.20}{and I humble myself under thy mighty hand.}
\pl{1.20}{I spread forth my hands unto thee,}
\pl{0.00}{My soul is unto thee as a thirsty land.}
\pl{2.40}{I smite upon my breast,}
\pl{2.40}{and say with the Publican,}
\pl{0.00}{God be merciful to me \{ a sinner, / a sinner utterly. \}}
\pl{2.40}{To me a sinner above the Publican}
\pl{2.40}{be merciful, even as to the Publican.}
\pl{2.40}{O Father of mercies,}
\pl{1.20}{I beseech thy fatherly compassion,}
\pl{1.20}{despise me not — \{ a foul worm, / a dead dog, / a rotten carcase. \}}
}

\pl{0.00}{quæcunque casta, quæcunque amabilia, quæcunque bonæ}

}

\pl{0.00}{Δὸς ἐμοὶ λαλεῖν εἰρήνην περὶ αὐτῶν,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ ἐκζητεῖν ἀγαθὰ αὐτοῖς.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ὁ βουλόμενος ἀνταμεῖψαι}
\pl{2.40}{ἡμᾶς τοῖς ἀγαθοποιοῦσι,}
\pl{0.00}{Μνήσθητι, Κύριε, εἰς ἀγαθὸν πάντων}
\pl{1.20}{ὑφ’ ὧν εὐπέπονθα·}

\pglabel{printed 58}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{1.20}{to be subject unto authority,}
\pl{1.20}{not only for wrath,}
\pl{2.40}{but also for conscience' sake.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{TO THE husbandmen and the herdsmen, a good year,}
\pl{1.20}{to the fleet and the fishers, fair seas;}
\pl{1.20}{to them that trade, not to overreach one another,}
\pl{1.20}{to the craftsmen, lawfully to work}
\pl{2.40}{at their own crafts;}
\pl{1.20}{yea, and even down unto the mean trades,}
\pl{1.20}{yea, and even down unto the poor.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O GOD, not of us alone,}
\pl{1.20}{but of our seed also;}
\pl{0.00}{Bless our children among us,}
\pl{1.20}{that they may go forward in wisdom,}
\pl{2.40}{as in stature, and in favour}
\pl{3.60}{with thee and with men.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O thou who wouldest have us care for our own,}
\pl{2.40}{and hatest them that are without natural affection,}
\pl{1.20}{Remember, O Lord, them that are my}
\pl{2.40}{kinsfolk after the flesh.}
\pl{0.00}{Grant me to speak peace concerning them,}
\pl{1.20}{and to seek out good things for them.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O thou who art minded to repay}
\pl{2.40}{us that do good to others,}
\pl{0.00}{Remember, O Lord, unto good all those}
\pl{1.20}{at whose hands I have received good;}
}

\pl{0.00}{Memor esto, Domine, meorum secundum carnem pro-}

\pl{1.20}{et illorum bona quærere.}

\pl{0.00}{Memor esto in bonum, Domine, omnium}

\pl{2.40}{εἰς θέλημα ἐχθρῶν.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ὁ τῶν οἰκείων ἀμελοῦντα}

\pl{0.00}{Μνήσθητι ἐν εὐδοκίᾳ σου πάντων}

\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ὁ θέλων περισσεύειν δικαιοσύνην ἡμῶν}

\pl{1.20}{Ἀνταγαπᾶν τοὺς ἀγαπῶντας ἐμὲ}

\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ὁ θέλων ἡμᾶς νικᾶν ἐν τῷ ἀγαθῷ τὸ κακὸν,}

\pl{3.60}{σου βασιλείαν, ὡς καὶ ἐμέ.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ὁ χαρισάμενος ταῖς προσευχαῖς τῶν δούλων σου}
\pl{1.20}{ὑπὲρ ἀλλήλων,}
\pl{0.00}{Μνήσθητι, Κύριε, εἰς ἀγαθὸν,}
\pl{0.00}{καὶ δῴης ἔλεος πᾶσι τοῖς ἐμὲ διὰ μνήμης ἔχουσιν,}
\pl{2.40}{ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς αὐτῶν·}

\pglabel{printed 60}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{Give them life, and count them blessed in the earth,}

\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O thou who him that is careless of his own}
\pl{1.20}{hast written down worse than an unbeliever,}
\pl{0.00}{Remember in thy good pleasure all them}
\pl{1.20}{that are within my stewardship.}

\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O thou who wouldest have our righteousness abound}

\pl{2.40}{My friends, and my father's friends,}
\pl{1.20}{and my friends' children, never to forsake.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O thou who wouldest have us overcome evil with good,}

\pl{1.20}{Have mercy upon mine enemies, O Lord,}

\pl{2.40}{and bring them unto thy heavenly}
\pl{3.60}{kingdom, even as me also.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O thou who hast granted the prayers of thy servants}

\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Vouchsafe also, O Lord, to remember}
\pl{1.20}{our Fathers in holiness,}
\pl{0.00}{the honourable Presbytery, and all the clergy,}
\pl{1.20}{rightly dividing the word of truth,}
\pl{1.20}{and walking uprightly therein.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Remember, O Lord, the brethren that stand round about us,}
\pl{1.20}{and pray together with us in this holy hour,}
\pl{1.20}{their earnestness and their zeal.}
}

\pglabel{printed 121}{Latin}

\pl{1.20}{Memento piorum et fidelium Regum,}
\pl{0.00}{quos dignos habuisti qui regnarent super terram.}
\pl{1.20}{Et in primis memento, Domine,}
\pl{1.20}{divinitus custoditi Regis nostri:}
\pl{2.40}{corrobora imperium ejus,}
\pl{1.20}{Subde sub illo omnes adversarios:}
\pl{2.40}{loquere ipsius cordi bona}
\pl{0.00}{Pro Ecclesia et omni populo tuo.}
\pl{1.20}{Concede illi profundam et illibatam pacem,}
\pl{2.40}{ut in ipsius tranquillitate}
\pl{1.20}{Tranquillam et quietam vitam degamus}
\pl{2.40}{cum omni pietate et castimonia. [1 \emph{Tim.} ii. 2.]}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Memento, Domine, omnis Principatus et}
\pl{3.60}{potestatis,}
\pl{2.40}{et Fratrum in Palatio,}
\pl{0.00}{Quique in concilio et foro eminent,}
\pl{1.20}{omniumque, qua terra, qua mari,}
\pl{2.40}{pro nobis tua bella gerentium.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Etiam meminisse, Domine, digneris}
\pl{1.20}{Sanctorum Patrum nostrorum,}
\pl{0.00}{Venerabilis Presbyterii, et universi Cleri,}
\pl{1.20}{Recte secantis verbum veritatis, [2 \emph{Tim.} ii. 15.]}
\pl{2.40}{et recto pede incedentis in eodem. [\emph{Gal.} ii. 14.]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Memento, Domine, fratrum nos circumstantium,}
\pl{1.20}{Et comprecantium nobiscum in ista hora sancta,}
\pl{2.40}{ob studium et alacritatem ipsorum.}

\pglabel{printed 122}{Greek}

\pl{0.00}{Μνήσθητι καὶ τῶν δι' εὐλόγους αἰτίας ἀπολειφθέντων,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ ἐλέησον αὐτοὺς καὶ ἡμᾶς}
\pl{2.40}{κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τοῦ ἐλέους σου.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Τὰ ταμεῖα ἡμῶν ἔμπλησον παντὸς ἀγαθοῦ,}
\pl{1.20}{τὰς συζυγίας ἡμῶν ἐν εἰρήνῃ καὶ ὁμονοίᾳ διατήρησον}
\pl{2.40}{τὰ νήπια ἔκθρεψον,}
\pl{2.40}{τὴν νεότητα παιδαγώγησον,}
\pl{2.40}{τὸ γῆρας περικράτησον,}
\pl{2.40}{τοὺς ὀλιγοψύχους παραμύθησαι,}
\pl{2.40}{τοὺς ἐσκορπισμένους ἐπισυνάγαγε,}
\pl{2.40}{τοὺς πεπλανημένους ἐπανάγαγε, καὶ}
\pl{0.00}{σύναψον τῇ ἁγίᾳ καὶ καθολικῇ καὶ ἀποστολικῇ}
\pl{2.40}{σου Ἐκκλησίᾳ·}
\pl{2.40}{τοὺς ὀχλουμένους ὑπὸ τῶν πνευμάτων}
\pl{3.60}{ἀκαθάρτων ἐλευθέρωσον}
\pl{2.40}{τοῖς πλέουσι σύμπλευσον,}
\pl{2.40}{τοῖς ὁδοιποροῦσι συνόδευσον,}
\pl{3.60}{χηρῶν πρόστηθι,}
\pl{3.60}{ὀρφανῶν ὑπεράσπισον,}
\pl{3.60}{αἰχμαλώτους ῥῦσαι,}
\pl{3.60}{νοσοῦντας ἴασαι·}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Τῶν ἐν βήμασι, καὶ μετάλλοις, καὶ ἐξορίαις,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ τριήρεσι, καὶ πάσῃ θλίψει, καὶ ἀνάγκῃ,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ περιστάσει ὄντων, μνημόνευσον ὁ Θεὸς,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ πάντων δεομένων}
\pl{2.40}{τῆς μεγάλης σου εὐσπλαγχνίας·}
\pl{0.00}{Καὶ τῶν ἀγαπώντων ἡμᾶς,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ τῶν μισούντων,}

\pglabel{printed 122}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{Remember also them that for good cause are absent,}
\pl{1.20}{and have mercy upon them and upon us}
\pl{2.40}{according to the multitude of thy mercy.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Fill our storehouses with all good things,}
\pl{1.20}{keep our marriages in peace and concord,}
\pl{2.40}{nourish the little children,}
\pl{2.40}{train up the youth,}
\pl{2.40}{uphold the aged,}
\pl{2.40}{comfort the fainthearted,}
\pl{2.40}{gather together them that are scattered,}
\pl{2.40}{bring back them that are gone astray, and}
\pl{0.00}{join them unto thy holy and catholic and apostolic}
\pl{2.40}{Church;}
\pl{2.40}{them that are vexed by the unclean}
\pl{3.60}{spirits, set free,}
\pl{2.40}{with them that sail, sail thou,}
\pl{2.40}{with them that journey, journey thou,}
\pl{3.60}{stand up for the widows,}
\pl{3.60}{shield the fatherless,}
\pl{3.60}{deliver the captives,}
\pl{3.60}{heal the sick;}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Them that are at the tribunals, and in the mines, and in banishments,}
\pl{1.20}{and in the galleys, and in all tribulation, and necessity,}
\pl{1.20}{and distress, remember, O God,}
\pl{1.20}{and all that stand in need}
\pl{2.40}{of thy great compassion;}
\pl{0.00}{Both them that love us,}
\pl{1.20}{and them that hate us,}
}

\pglabel{printed 123}{Latin}

\pl{0.00}{Memento et eorum, qui justis de causis absunt,}
\pl{1.20}{et miserere illis sicut et nobis,}
\pl{2.40}{secundum multitudinem misericordiæ tuæ.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Promptuaria nostra reple omni bono, [\emph{Psal.} cxliv. 13.]}
\pl{0.00}{Conjugia nostra in pace et concordia conserva,}
\pl{2.40}{Enutri infantes,}
\pl{1.20}{Juventutem erudi,}
\pl{1.20}{Senectutem sustenta,}
\pl{1.20}{Pusillanimes consolare, [1 \emph{Thess.} v. 14.]}
\pl{1.20}{Dispersos congrega,}
\pl{1.20}{Errantes reduc, et}
\pl{0.00}{Sanctæ tuæ, et Catholicæ, et Apostolicæ}
\pl{2.40}{Ecclesiæ annecte:}
\pl{1.20}{Vexatos a spiritibus}
\pl{2.40}{Immundis libera;}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Navigantibus, navigationis}
\pl{0.00}{Viatoribus, itineris \} comes accede,}
\pl{2.40}{Viduis patrocinare,}
\pl{2.40}{Pupillos protege,}
\pl{2.40}{Captivos libera,}
\pl{2.40}{Ægrotantibus medere.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Qui ad tribunalia, et in metallis, et exsiliis}
\pl{1.20}{et triremibus, et omni angustia, et necessitate,}
\pl{2.40}{et adversitate sunt, eorum memento, Deus,}
\pl{3.60}{et omnium qui indigent}
\pl{4.80}{magna tua misericordia;}
\pl{0.00}{Et diligentium nos,}
\pl{1.20}{et odio habentium,}

\pglabel{printed 124}{Greek}

\pl{1.20}{καὶ τῶν ἐντειλαμένων ἡμῖν τοῖς ἀναξίοις,}
\pl{2.40}{ὥστε μνημονεύειν αὐτῶν ἐν ταῖς}
\pl{2.40}{προσευχαῖς ἡμῶν.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Καὶ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ σου μνήσθητι, Κύριε, ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ ἐπὶ πάντας ἔκχεον τὸ πλούσιόν σου ἔλεος,}
\pl{1.20}{πᾶσι παρέχων τὰ πρὸς σωτηρίαν αἰτήματα.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Καὶ ὧν ἡμεῖς οὐκ ἐμνημονεύσαμεν,}
\pl{0.00}{δι' ἄγνοιαν, ἢ λήθην, ἢ πλῆθος ὀνομάτων,}
\pl{1.20}{αὐτὸς μνημόνευσον ὁ Θεὸς, ὁ εἰδὼς}
\pl{0.00}{ἑκάστου τὴν ἡλικίαν, καὶ τὴν προσηγορίαν,}
\pl{1.20}{ὁ εἰδὼς ἕκαστον ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς αὐτοῦ.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Σὺ γὰρ εἶ, Κύριε, ἡ βοήθεια τῶν ἀβοηθήτων,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ ἡ ἐλπὶς τῶν ἀπελπισμένων,}
\pl{2.40}{ὁ τῶν χειμαζομένων σωτὴρ,}
\pl{2.40}{ὁ τῶν πλεόντων λιμὴν,}
\pl{2.40}{ὁ τῶν νοσούντων ἰατρὸς,}
\pl{1.20}{αὐτὸς τοῖς πᾶσι τὰ πάντα γενοῦ.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Ὁ εἰδὼς ἕκαστον καὶ τὸ αἴτημα αὐτοῦ,}
\pl{1.20}{οἶκον καὶ τὴν χρείαν αὐτοῦ,}
\pl{0.00}{Ῥῦσαι, Κύριε, τὴν πόλιν ταύτην, καὶ}
\pl{1.20}{πᾶσαν τὴν χώραν ἐν ᾗ παροικοῦμεν,}
\pl{1.20}{ἀπὸ λοιμοῦ, λιμοῦ, σεισμοῦ, καταποντισμοῖ,}
\pl{1.20}{πυρὸς, μαχαίρας, ἐπιδρομῆς ἀλλοφύλων,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ ἐμφυλίου στασιασμοῦ.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Παῦσον τὰ σχίσματα τῶν Ἐκκλησιῶν,}
\pl{1.20}{σβέσον τὰ φρυάγματα τῶν ἐθνῶν,}
\pl{0.00}{Καὶ πάντας ἡμᾶς πρόσδεξαι εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν σου,}

\pglabel{printed 124}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{1.20}{and them that have charged us, unworthy as we are,}
\pl{2.40}{to make mention of them in our}
\pl{2.40}{prayers.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{And remember all thy people, O Lord our God,}
\pl{1.20}{and pour out upon all thy rich mercy,}
\pl{1.20}{affording unto all the petitions that are unto salvation.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{And those whom we have not remembered,}
\pl{0.00}{through ignorance, or forgetfulness, or the multitude of names,}
\pl{1.20}{do thou thyself remember, O God, who knowest}
\pl{0.00}{the age and the name of every one,}
\pl{1.20}{who knowest each one from his mother's womb.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{For thou, O Lord, art the help of the helpless,}
\pl{1.20}{and the hope of the hopeless,}
\pl{2.40}{the saviour of the tempest-tossed,}
\pl{2.40}{the haven of them that sail,}
\pl{2.40}{the physician of the sick;}
\pl{1.20}{be thou thyself all things unto all.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Thou that knowest each man and his petition,}
\pl{1.20}{his house and his need,}
\pl{0.00}{Deliver, O Lord, this city, and}
\pl{1.20}{all the country wherein we sojourn,}
\pl{1.20}{from plague, famine, earthquake, flood,}
\pl{1.20}{fire, sword, the invasion of aliens,}
\pl{2.40}{and civil strife.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Make the schisms of the Churches to cease,}
\pl{1.20}{quench the ragings of the nations,}
\pl{0.00}{And receive us all into thy kingdom,}
}

\pglabel{printed 125}{Latin}

\pl{1.20}{et mandantium nobis indignis,}
\pl{2.40}{ut memoriam illorum in orationibus}
\pl{2.40}{nostris haberemus.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Et omnis populi tui memento, Domine, Deus noster,}
\pl{1.20}{et super omnes effunde divitem tuam misericordiam,}
\pl{2.40}{omnibus præbens ad salutem requisita.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Et quorum nos non meminimus,}
\pl{0.00}{per ignorantiam, aut oblivionem, aut nominum multitudinem,}
\pl{1.20}{Ipse memento Deus, qui nosti}
\pl{0.00}{Uniuscujusque ætatem et appellationem,}
\pl{1.20}{qui nosti unumquemque ex utero matris ejus.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Tu enim es, Domine, opitulator inopum,}
\pl{2.40}{et spes desperantium,}
\pl{2.40}{Fluctuantium servator,}
\pl{2.40}{Navigantium portus,}
\pl{2.40}{Ægrotantium medicus,}
\pl{1.20}{Ipse omnibus omnia fias.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Qui nosti \{ hominem et desiderium ejus, / domum et necessitatem ejus, \}}
\pl{0.00}{Libera, Domine, istam civitatem, et}
\pl{1.20}{omnem regionem in qua inhabitamus,}
\pl{2.40}{a peste, fame, terræ motu, diluvio,}
\pl{2.40}{igne, gladio, invasione hostili,}
\pl{3.60}{et civili bello.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Compesce schismata Ecclesiarum,}
\pl{1.20}{Exstingue fremitus Gentium,}
\pl{0.00}{Et nos omnes recipe in Regnum tuum,}

\pglabel{printed 126}{Greek}

\pl{0.00}{Υἱοὺς φωτὸς ἀναδείξας·}

\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Μνήσθητι, Κύριε, ὁ Θεὸς,}
\pl{0.00}{πάντων πνευμάτων, καὶ πάσης σαρκὸς,}
\pl{1.20}{ὧν ἐμνήσθημεν, καὶ ὧν οὐκ ἐμνήσθημεν.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ἡμῶν δὲ τὰ τέλη τῆς ζωῆς}
\pl{0.00}{Χριστιανὰ, εὐάρεστα (κἄν σοι δοκῇ)}
\pl{2.40}{ἀνώδυνα,}
\pl{1.20}{ἐν εἰρήνῃ κατεύθυνον, Κύριε, Κύριε,}
\pl{0.00}{Ἐπισυνάγων ἡμᾶς ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν σου,}
\pl{2.40}{ὅτε θέλεις, καὶ ὡς θέλεις,}
\pl{2.40}{μόνον χωρὶς αἰσχύνης,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ ἁμαρτημάτων.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ἔστω ἡ λαμπρότης τοῦ Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν}
\pl{2.40}{ἐφ' ἡμᾶς,}
\pl{1.20}{Καὶ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν ἡμῶν κατεύθυνον}
\pl{2.40}{ἐφ' ἡμᾶς,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ τὸ ἔργον τῶν χειρῶν ἡμῶν κατεύθυνον.}
\parasep
\pl{2.40}{Ἴσθι Κύριε}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ἐντός | ἐνισχῦσαί}
\pl{0.00}{ἐκτός | φυλάξαι}
\pl{0.00}{ὑπέρ | σκεπάσαι}
\pl{0.00}{ὑπό | ἀντερεῖσαί}
\pl{0.00}{πρόσω | κατευθῦναί}
\pl{0.00}{ὀπίσω | ἀναγαγεῖν,}
\pl{0.00}{κύκλῳ περί | ὀχυρῶσαί,}

\pglabel{printed 126}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{having declared us sons of light;}
\pl{0.00}{And thine own peace and love}
\pl{1.20}{grant unto us, O Lord our God.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Remember, O Lord God,}
\pl{0.00}{of all spirits, and of all flesh,}
\pl{1.20}{whom we have remembered, and whom we have not remembered.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{And the ends of our life}
\pl{0.00}{Christian, well-pleasing (if so it seem good to thee)}
\pl{2.40}{and without pain,}
\pl{1.20}{order thou in peace, O Lord, O Lord,}
\pl{0.00}{gathering us together beneath the feet of thine elect,}
\pl{2.40}{when thou wilt, and as thou wilt,}
\pl{2.40}{only without shame,}
\pl{2.40}{and without sins.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Let the beauty of the Lord our God be}
\pl{2.40}{upon us,}
\pl{1.20}{And the works of our hands establish thou}
\pl{2.40}{upon us,}
\pl{1.20}{yea, the work of our hands establish thou.}

\pl{2.40}{Be thou, O Lord,}

\pl{0.00}{within | strengthen}

\pl{0.00}{before | direct}
\pl{0.00}{behind | bring back,}
\pl{0.00}{round about | fortify,}
}

\pl{0.00}{Filios lucis comprobans,}
\pl{0.00}{Tuamque Pacem et Charitatem}

\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Memento, Domine Deus,}
\pl{0.00}{omnium spirituum, et omnis carnis}
\pl{1.20}{quorum mentionem habuimus, et quorum non habuimus.}

\pl{1.20}{Nobis autem exitus Vitæ}
\pl{0.00}{Christianos, tibi acceptos et (si videbitur)}

\pl{1.20}{in pace dirige, Domine, Domine,}
\pl{0.00}{Colligens nos sub pedes electorum tuorum,}

\pl{2.40}{et peccatis.}
\parasep
\pl{1.20}{Sit splendor Domini nostri}
\pl{2.40}{super nos,}

\pl{2.40}{super nos,}

\pl{2.40}{Esto, Domine,}

\pl{0.00}{Circumcirca | undique communias.}

\pglabel{printed 128}{Greek}

\pl{0.00}{ΕΥΛΟΓΗΤΟΣ εἶ, Κύριε, ὁ Θεὸς Ἰσραὴλ,}
\pl{1.20}{ὁ Πατὴρ ἡμῶν,}
\pl{0.00}{ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος.}
\pl{2.40}{Σοὶ, Κύριε,}
\pl{1.20}{ἡ μεγαλωσύνη,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ ἡ δύναμις,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ τὸ καύχημα,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ ἡ νίκη,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ ἡ ἐξομολόγησις,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ ἡ ἰσχὺς,}
\pl{0.00}{ὅτι σὺ πάντων ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς δεσπόζεις.}
\pl{0.00}{Ἀπὸ προσώπου σου ταράσσεται πᾶς βασιλεὺς,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ πᾶν ἔθνος.}
\pl{1.20}{Σοὶ, Κύριε, ἡ βασιλεία,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ ἡ ἔπαρσις εἰς πάντα,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ εἰς πᾶσαν ἀρχήν.}
\pl{0.00}{Παρὰ σοῦ ὁ πλοῦτος, καὶ ἡ δόξα ἐκ προσώπου σου.}
\pl{1.20}{Σὺ πάντων ἄρχεις, Κύριε,}
\pl{2.40}{ὁ ἄρχων πάσης ἀρχῆς,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ ἐν χειρί σου ἰσχὺς, καὶ δυναστεία,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ ἐν χειρί σου μεγαλῦναι,}
\pl{2.40}{καὶ κατισχῦσαι τὰ πάντα.}
\pl{0.00}{Καὶ νῦν, Κύριε, ἐξομολογούμεθά σοι}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ αἰνοῦμεν τὸ ὄνομα τῆς καυχήσεώς σου.}

\pglabel{printed 128}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{BLESSED art thou, O Lord, the God of Israel,}
\pl{1.20}{our Father,}
\pl{0.00}{from everlasting to everlasting.}
\pl{2.40}{Thine, O Lord,}
\pl{1.20}{is the greatness,}
\pl{2.40}{and the power,}
\pl{2.40}{and the glory,}
\pl{2.40}{and the victory,}
\pl{2.40}{and the praise,}
\pl{2.40}{and the might,}
\pl{0.00}{for thou art over all in heaven,}
\pl{1.20}{and rulest upon the earth.}
\pl{0.00}{At thy presence every king is troubled,}
\pl{1.20}{and every nation.}
\pl{1.20}{Thine, O Lord, is the kingdom,}
\pl{1.20}{and the exaltation above all,}
\pl{2.40}{and above all rule.}
\pl{0.00}{Of thee cometh riches, and glory cometh from thy presence.}
\pl{1.20}{Thou reignest over all, O Lord,}
\pl{2.40}{the ruler of all rule,}
\pl{1.20}{and in thine hand is power and might,}
\pl{2.40}{and in thine hand it is to make great,}
\pl{2.40}{and to give strength unto all.}
\pl{0.00}{And now, O Lord, we give thee thanks,}
\pl{1.20}{and praise thy glorious name.}
}

\pglabel{printed 129}{Latin}

\pl{1.20}{BENEDICTUS es, Domine, Deus Israel,}
\pl{2.40}{Pater noster,}
\pl{1.20}{ab æterno in æternum, 1 \emph{Chron.} xxix. 10.}
\pl{2.40}{Tua est, Domine,}
\pl{1.20}{Magnificentia,}
\pl{2.40}{et Potentia,}
\pl{2.40}{et Gloria,}
\pl{2.40}{atque Victoria,}
\pl{2.40}{[et laus,}
\pl{2.40}{et potestas,]}
\pl{0.00}{Cuncta enim quæ in cœlo sunt,}
\pl{1.20}{et in terra tua sunt. [\emph{Vers.} 11.]}
\pl{0.00}{A vultu tuo conturbatur omnis Rex,}
\pl{1.20}{Et gens omnis. [\emph{Is.} lxiv. 2.]}
\pl{1.20}{Tuum, Domine, Regnum,}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{HOSANNA IN THE HIGHEST.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{REMEMBER me, O Lord,}
\pl{1.20}{with the favour of thy people,}
\pl{0.00}{O visit me with thy salvation,}
\pl{1.20}{that I may see the good of thy chosen,}
\pl{1.20}{that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation,}
\pl{2.40}{that I may give thanks unto thee with thine inheritance.}
\pl{0.00}{For there is a glory that shall be revealed.}
\pl{2.40}{For when the Judge cometh,}
\pl{1.20}{some shall see his face gladsome,}
\pl{0.00}{they shall be set on the right hand,}
\pl{1.20}{they shall hear the sweetest voice,}
\pl{2.40}{Come, ye blessed.}
\pl{0.00}{They shall be caught up in the clouds to}
\pl{1.20}{meet the Lord,}
\pl{0.00}{they shall enter into the joy,}
\pl{1.20}{they shall have the fruition of the sight of him,}
\pl{2.40}{they shall ever be with him.}
\pl{0.00}{They alone, they only, are blessed}
\pl{1.20}{among the sons of men.}
\pl{0.00}{O grant me, the last, a last place there,}
\pl{1.20}{beneath their feet;}
\pl{0.00}{beneath the feet of thy chosen,}
\pl{1.20}{the least among them.}
\pl{2.40}{And that this may be,}
}

\sectionhead{The Evening Office}

\pglabel{printed 220}{Greek}

\pl{0.00}{[Ἡ ΔΕΙΛΙΝΗ ΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΙΑ.]}

\pl{0.00}{ΤΗΝ ἡμέραν διαβὰς}
\pl{1.20}{εὐχαριστῶ σοι, Κύριε.}
\pl{2.40}{Ἐγγίζει ἡ ἑσπέρα,}
\pl{1.20}{φαιδρὰν αὐτὴν χορήγει.}
\pl{0.00}{Ἑσπέρα ὥσπερ τῆς ἡμέρας,}
\pl{1.20}{οὕτω καὶ τῆς ζωῆς ἐστι,}
\pl{0.00}{Ἑσπέρα τῆς ζωῆς τὸ γῆρας,}
\pl{2.40}{ἔφθασέ με γῆρας,}
\pl{2.40}{φαιδρὸν αὐτὸ χορήγει.}
\pl{0.00}{Μή με ἀπορρίψῃς εἰς καιρὸν γήρως,}
\pl{1.20}{ἐν τῷ ἐκλείπειν τὴν ἰσχύν μου,}
\pl{2.40}{μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς με.}
\pl{0.00}{Ἕως γήρως ἴσθι σὺ,}
\pl{1.20}{ἕως ἂν καταγηράσω ἀνέχου μου·}
\pl{0.00}{Αὐτὸς ποίησον, καὶ αὐτὸς ἄνες,}
\pl{1.20}{καὶ αὐτὸς ἀνάληψαι, καὶ}
\pl{2.40}{σῶσόν με, Κύριε.}
\pl{0.00}{Μεῖνον μετ' ἐμοῦ, Κύριε,}
\pl{1.20}{ἤδη γὰρ πρὸς ἑσπέραν μοι ἐστὶ,}
\pl{0.00}{καὶ κέκλικεν ἡ ἡμέρα}
\pl{1.20}{τῆσδε τῆς πολυμόχθου ζωῆς.}
\pl{0.00}{Τελειωθήτω ἡ δύναμίς σου}
\pl{1.20}{ἐν τῇ ἀσθενείᾳ μου.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{Ὤχετ' ἀπιοῦσα ἡ ἡμέρα,}
\pl{1.20}{οἴχεται καὶ ὁ βίος,}
\pl{2.40}{ὁ βίος ἄβιος.}

\pglabel{printed 220}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{[THE EVENING OFFICE.]}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{NOW that I have passed through the day,}
\pl{1.20}{I give thee thanks, O Lord.}
\pl{2.40}{The evening draweth nigh,}
\pl{1.20}{grant it bright.}
\pl{0.00}{As is the evening of the day,}
\pl{1.20}{so also is the evening of life;}
\pl{0.00}{The evening of life is old age,}
\pl{2.40}{old age hath overtaken me,}
\pl{2.40}{grant it bright.}
\pl{0.00}{Cast me not off in the time of old age;}
\pl{1.20}{when my strength faileth,}
\pl{2.40}{forsake me not.}
\pl{0.00}{Be thou the same even unto old age,}
\pl{1.20}{until I grow grey, bear thou with me;}
\pl{0.00}{Do thou it thyself, and thyself bear me,}
\pl{1.20}{and thyself take me up, and}
\pl{2.40}{save me, O Lord.}
\pl{0.00}{Abide with me, O Lord,}
\pl{1.20}{for it is now toward evening with me,}
\pl{0.00}{and the day is far spent}
\pl{1.20}{of this toilsome life.}
\pl{0.00}{Let thy power be made perfect}
\pl{1.20}{in my weakness.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{The day is gone and passed away,}
\pl{1.20}{and life too passeth,}
\pl{2.40}{life that is no life.}
}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{Night cometh,}

\pl{0.00}{O LORD,}

\pl{1.20}{so also do we add sin upon sin.}

\pl{2.40}{in thy goodness.}

\pl{2.40}{my rising-up,}
\pl{1.20}{from this time forth and even for evermore.}
\pl{0.00}{To be mindful of thee upon my bed,}
\pl{1.20}{to search out my spirit,}
\pl{2.40}{to awake, and}
\pl{2.40}{to be still with thee.}
\pl{0.00}{In peace will I both lay me down,}
\pl{2.40}{and sleep;}
\pl{1.20}{for thou, Lord, only,}
\pl{2.40}{shalt make me dwell in hope.}

\pglabel{printed 244}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{Remembering therefore, O Master, we also,}
\pl{0.00}{in the presence of thy holy Mysteries,}
\pl{1.20}{the saving sufferings of thy Christ,}
\pl{2.40}{the life-giving Cross,}
\pl{2.40}{the most precious Death,}
\pl{2.40}{the three-days' Burial,}
\pl{2.40}{the Resurrection from the dead,}
\pl{2.40}{the Ascension into the heavens,}
\pl{2.40}{the Sitting at thy right hand, O Father,}
\pl{2.40}{his glorious and fearful}
\pl{2.40}{coming again,}
\pl{0.00}{We beseech thee, O Lord,}
\pl{2.40}{that in the pure witness}
\pl{3.60}{of our conscience}
\pl{1.20}{receiving the portion}
\pl{2.40}{of thy hallowed gifts,}
\pl{0.00}{we may be made one with the holy Body and Blood}
\pl{2.40}{of thy Christ;}
\pl{1.20}{and receiving them not unworthily,}
\pl{2.40}{may have Christ dwelling}
\pl{3.60}{in our hearts,}
\pl{1.20}{and may become a temple of thy Holy}
\pl{2.40}{Spirit;}
\pl{2.40}{Yea, O our God.}
\pl{0.00}{And make thou none of us guilty}
\pl{1.20}{of these thy dread and}
\pl{2.40}{heavenly Mysteries,}
\pl{0.00}{neither weak in soul or body,}
\pl{1.20}{through partaking of them}
\pl{2.40}{unworthily.}
}

\parasep
\pl{0.00}{ΠΑΤΕΡ ἄναρχε, Υἱὲ μονογενὴς,}

\pl{2.40}{Θεὸς μετανοούντων,}
\pl{2.40}{Σωτὴρ ἁμαρτανόντων·}
\pl{0.00}{Ἥμαρτον ἐναντίον σου, Κύριε,}
\pl{1.20}{Καὶ οὕτω καὶ οὕτως ἐποίησα.}
\pl{2.40}{Ἔα, ἔα. Φεῦ, φεῦ.}
\pl{0.00}{Πῶς ἐδελεαζόμην ὑπὸ τῆς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας;}
\pl{1.20}{Πῶς ἐμίσησα παιδείαν;}
\pl{0.00}{Καὶ οὐκ ηὐλαβήθην, οὔτ' ᾐδεόμην,}
\pl{2.40}{τὸ ἀκατάληπτον τῆς δόξης,}
\pl{2.40}{τὸ αἰδέσιμον τῆς παρουσίας,}
\pl{2.40}{τὸ φοβερὸν τῆς δυνάμεως,}
\pl{2.40}{τὸ ἀκριβὲς τῆς δικαιοσύνης,}
\pl{2.40}{τὸ προσφιλὲς τῆς ἀγαθωσύνης.}
\pl{0.00}{Ἐπικαλέσομαι, εἴτις μοι ὑπακούσεται,}
\pl{1.20}{Εἰς τίνα ἀγγέλων ἁγίων ὄψομαι;}
\pl{2.40}{Ταλαίπωρος ἐγὼ ἄνθρωπος!}
\pl{0.00}{Τίς με ῥύσεται ἐκ τοῦ σώματος τοῦ θανάτου τούτου;}

\pglabel{printed 252}{English}

{\itshape
\pl{0.00}{MEDITATION I.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{OF THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT.}
\parasep
\pl{0.00}{O FATHER without beginning, O only-begotten Son,}
\pl{2.40}{O quickening Spirit,}
\pl{1.20}{pitiful, merciful, longsuffering,}
\pl{2.40}{of great mercy, of many tender compassions,}
\pl{1.20}{who lovest the righteous, and hast mercy on sinners,}
\pl{1.20}{who passest over sins, and grantest petitions,}
\pl{2.40}{God of them that repent,}
\pl{2.40}{Saviour of them that sin;}
\pl{0.00}{I have sinned before thee, O Lord,}
\pl{1.20}{and thus and thus have I done.}
\pl{2.40}{Ah, ah! alas, alas!}
\pl{0.00}{How was I enticed by mine own lust?}
\pl{1.20}{How did I hate instruction?}
\pl{0.00}{And I neither reverenced, nor stood in awe of,}
\pl{2.40}{the incomprehensibleness of thy glory,}
\pl{2.40}{the awfulness of thy presence,}
\pl{2.40}{the terribleness of thy power,}
\pl{2.40}{the exactness of thy justice,}
\pl{2.40}{the loveliness of thy goodness.}
\pl{0.00}{I will call, if there be any that will answer me;}
\pl{1.20}{to which of the holy angels shall I look?}
\pl{2.40}{O wretched man that I am!}
\pl{0.00}{Who shall deliver me from the body of this death?}
}
